prompt: R&B, soulful, piano, strings, 70 bpm, heartfelt, emotional, female vocals, nostalgic, uplifting
lyrics:
[verse 1]
In the quiet of the night, I hear your heart,
Every whisper, every tear, a work of art.
You gave your all, through the pain and the strife,
A warrior's spirit, you fought for my life.

[chorus]
Oh, Mom, you’re my guiding star,
Through the darkest nights, you’ve come so far.
With every struggle, every silent prayer,
You showed me love beyond compare.

[verse 2]
I remember the nights when you held me tight,
Through the storms of doubt, you were my light.
You sacrificed dreams, but never your grace,
Every smile you wore, a warm embrace.

[chorus]
Oh, Mom, you’re my guiding star,
Through the darkest nights, you’ve come so far.
With every struggle, every silent prayer,
You showed me love beyond compare.

[bridge]
Now I stand tall, with dreams in my hand,
But it’s your strength that helped me to stand.
Though miles may stretch between us now,
In my heart, I’ll always vow.

[verse 3]
To honor your fight, to cherish your name,
In every success, I’ll share your flame.
You taught me to rise, to never lose hope,
With your love as my anchor, I learned how to cope.

[chorus]
Oh, Mom, you’re my guiding star,
Through the darkest nights, you’ve come so far.
With every struggle, every silent prayer,
You showed me love beyond compare.

[outro]
So here’s to you, my heart’s true song,
For all the battles, for being so strong.
Though time may pass, and I may roam,
Forever, dear Mom, you’ll be my home.
